posts.title: The concepts of forking
posts.description: Lately there has been a lot of discussion about “hard” or “soft” forks related to MySQL. As someone who has done a successful fork of MySQL, I think this is both confusing and trivialising the concept of forking. posts.title: Celebrating 15 years of MariaDB
posts.description: It is 15 years since the first MariaDB server release of MariaDB 5.1.38 on 29'th of October 2009. MariaDB got its name from my youngest daughter Maria, following the tradition of MySQL, who got its name from my oldest daughter My.
